text:
morgan: Kicking off SDK release window — Python 2.6.0 and TS 2.6.0. Also publishing a soft-deprecation notice for the legacy sync client. Release notes: short changelog + migration guide link.

jamie: change window is 2h starting 2026-06-01 18:00 UTC? Can we move earlier if EMEA needs it?

sarah: EMEA prefers 17:00 UTC. We should pick 17:00 to minimize overlap with support.

alex: npm/pypi publishing plan: we'll publish npm under @redwood/sdk@2.6.0 with dist-tag 'next' then promote to 'latest' after 30m canary. Py will upload to testpypi, smoke, then pypi. CI artifacts already built.

morgan: sounds good. Rollback criteria: 10% error rate increase on createClient endpoints OR packaging sig mismatch on install

jamie: add monitoring check for both clients (browser + node). If errors hit threshold auto-revert npm tag to previous and cut hotfix branch.

sarah: docs: I'll patch migration guide and add deprecation blurb in README + changelog. Ping @support after publish with canned response for users.

release-bot: CI pipeline started: build-js, build-py, unit-tests, smoke-tests. CI #4821

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed (lint, semver, signatures). Ready to publish when you say :thumbsup:

alex: executing npm publish step in 10 — command:
```
npm publish --tag next
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.6.0 next
```

morgan: do it.

deploy-bot: publishing npm @redwood/sdk@2.6.0 -> next ... done

deploy-bot: uploading wheel and sdist to testpypi ... done

release-bot: smoke-tests running against canary npm:@redwood/sdk@2.6.0

jamie: smoke result: OK on node and browser, latency stable

morgan: wait 30m then promote to latest unless we see regressions. I'll post release notes and deprecation notice then.

sarah: docs updated and PR merged. changelog entry: "Deprecate legacy sync client: use async client; see migration guide"

deploy-bot: 30m timer started

release-bot: observability hooks attached: error-rate, p50/p95 latency, install success rate

alex: if rollback, flow is: npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk@2.6.0 latest && npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.5.9 latest; for pypi yank release and reupload previous wheel.

jamie: noted. I'll be on-call for the window.

morgan: thanks everyone. I'll post the formal announcement in #announcements post-cutover with notes + deprecation link :shipit:

deploy-bot: 30m timer expired. No regressions. Promoting npm tag next -> latest.

deploy-bot: npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.6.0 latest -> done

deploy-bot: testpypi -> pypi publish in flight ... done

release-bot: release published: python==2.6.0, @redwood/sdk==2.6.0. Release notes: https://redwood.dev/releases/2.6.0

morgan: annoucement posted. Closing thread. :tada:
